verifications.claim: Northern Ireland is a country within the United Kingdom.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Northern Ireland is one of the four countries of the United Kingdom'; R4: 'Northern Ireland is a part of the United Kingdom... variously described as a country, province or region.'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in multiple sources as one of the UK's countries or parts.

verifications.claim: Northern Ireland is located on the island of Ireland.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the smaller of the two political entities on the island of Ireland'; R2: 'situated in the north-east of the island of Ireland'; R4: 'in the north-east of the island of Ireland.'

verifications.claim: Northern Ireland comprises six counties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'formed from six of the nine counties of Ulster'; R4: 'six northeastern counties'; R8: 'six historic counties.'
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed as six counties in historical and geographical contexts.

verifications.claim: Belfast is the capital of Northern Ireland.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Belfast Metropolitan Area dominates'; R4: 'Capital and largest city Belfast'; R6: 'capital: Belfast'.
verifications.reasoning: Directly identified as capital in all relevant sources.

verifications.claim: Northern Ireland was established in 1921.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'created as a separate legal entity on 3 May 1921'; R4: 'created in 1921'; R11: 'partitioned by UK authorities in the early 1920s'.

verifications.claim: Northern Ireland was created in 1921 as a separate entity from six northeastern counties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'formed from six of the nine counties of Ulster'; R4: 'six northeastern counties'; R6: 'six counties'.

verifications.claim: The six northeastern counties had a Protestant unionist majority.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'When Northern Ireland was created, it had a Protestant majority of approximately two-to-one'; R2: 'four counties with unionist majorities... two counties with slight Irish nationalist majorities'.
verifications.reasoning: Overall Protestant majority intended and achieved, though two counties had slim nationalist majorities.

verifications.claim: Northern Ireland's creation followed the partition of Ireland.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'partitioned the island into Northern Ireland (six northeastern counties)'; R4: 'partitioned by the Government of Ireland Act 1920'.

verifications.claim: The Troubles occurred c. 1968–1998.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'erupted in the late 1960s... until the 1998 Belfast Agreement'; R7: 'c. 1968–1998'; R10: 'late 1960s and the late 1990s'; R11: '1969 and 1999'.
verifications.reasoning: Dates vary slightly (1968/69 to 1998/99), but broadly matches three decades.

verifications.claim: The Troubles were three decades of conflict between republican (mostly Catholic) paramilitaries and loyalist (mostly Protestant) paramilitaries.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'conflict between republican... and loyalist paramilitaries'; R4: 'between pro-UK Protestants and pro-secession Catholics'; R10: 'pro-UK Protestants... pro-secession Catholics'.

verifications.claim: The Troubles resulted in over 3,500 deaths.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R10: 'killed more than 3,500 people'; R11: 'roughly 3,500 people died'.

verifications.claim: The Good Friday Agreement was in 1998.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All sources: '1998 Good Friday Agreement' or 'Belfast Agreement of 1998'.

verifications.claim: The Good Friday Agreement largely ended the conflict.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'brought to an uneasy end by... Good Friday Agreement'; R4: 'brought the Troubles to an uneasy end'; R10: 'achieved compromise... dampened sectarian conflict'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources state it ended the main violence, though sporadic issues persist.

verifications.claim: The Good Friday Agreement established a devolved power-sharing government.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'created a power-sharing government'; R10: 'power-sharing government'; R11: 'power-sharing in the devolved government'.

verifications.claim: The Good Friday Agreement established the Northern Ireland Assembly.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Northern Ireland Assembly'; R10: 'Northern Ireland Assembly'; R11: 'Northern Ireland Assembly'.

verifications.claim: Northern Ireland is located in the northeast of Ireland.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'north-east of the island of Ireland'; R4: 'north-east of the island of Ireland'; R6: 'northeastern portion'.

verifications.claim: Northern Ireland features the Mourne Mountains.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Northern Ireland features the Giant’s Causeway.
